title: Insulin Pump Program Account Statement Terms: Balance, Adjustments, Refunds and Payment Plans
content:
**The balance.** The customer's balance on an Insulin Pump Program is the running total of its patient-balance postings: remittance patient responsibility, patient charges and refunds add to it, and payments and balance adjustments reduce it; a payment is applied to the oldest unpaid posting first.

**Adjustments.** A balance adjustment is posted only for one of these reasons, each against the one posting it adjusts and never for more than that posting's unpaid remainder. *This unpaid-remainder limit is no longer in force for a hardship waiver, for a billing correction against a non-covered item charge, or for a billing correction against a remittance posting under review, each of which follows its current rule; every other balance adjustment remains under it.*

| Reason | When it is used |
|---|---|
| Return credit | an accepted self-pay return, for the price paid for the returned units less the restocking fee percent |
| Secondary payer payment | the amount a secondary payer paid against a remittance's patient responsibility |
| Hardship waiver | under the hardship terms below |
| Small-balance write-off | under the small-balance terms below |
| Billing correction | a posting made in error, or a timely-filing write-off |

**Hardship waivers.** A hardship waiver is granted only on tiers where hardship waivers are allowed, only for postings named on a hardship application whose request status is approved, and only after Larkfield's financial counseling team confirms household income at or below the tier's hardship income ceiling as a percent of the HHS poverty guideline; it is never granted routinely, never advertised and never granted on the customer's statement alone.

**Small balances.** A small-balance write-off is made only when the whole remaining balance of the program is greater than $0.00 and no more than the tier's small-balance write-off ceiling; on tiers where that ceiling is $0.00 no write-off is made and the balance is statemented.

| Hypothetical whole balance (ceiling $4.99) | Small-balance write-off |
|---|---|
| $0.00 | No — the balance must be greater than zero |
| $4.99 | Yes |
| $5.00 | No — statemented |

**Credit balances.** A credit balance — a balance below zero — is refunded to the original payment method no later than the tier's credit-balance refund limit in calendar days after the posting date of the entry that created it, unless the customer asks in writing to keep it on account; a refund never exceeds the credit.

**Payment plans.** A payment plan is offered only on tiers where the maximum plan months is greater than 0, for a balance of at least the tier's payment-plan minimum balance, in no more than the tier's maximum plan months of monthly installments of at least the tier's minimum monthly installment. It is created as a payment plan request the customer accepts, and while an approved plan's installments are current the balance it covers is left out of the past-due test that decides a shipment hold.

superseded_clauses: never for more than that posting's unpaid remainder
